description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger Your Answer's Strike hits, and before the start of your next turn a different creature threatens your Ward.

Answering once carries you into the next Answer without stopping to pay for it.

You Answer the new threat without using a reaction and without spending anything. As part of either Answer you can Stride up to half your Speed toward your Ward or toward the creature you are Answering. A round can hold at most one Answer from this feat, and it stacks with Twin Answer's extra reaction — up to three Answers in a round, each against a different creature.
